Perfect Strike: May use the best of 2 rolls when attacking w/a bow 20/dy

Point-Blank Master: Using chosen ranged weapon while threatened provokes no AOO

Power Attack: Can suffer -4 attack to inflict +8 HP, or +12 HP when attacking two-handed

Swap Places: May swap places w/an adjacent ally who has this feat; ally suffers no AOO

Unarmed Strike: Can make an Unarmed Strike when hands are full and adds full Strength modifier to all Unarmed Strike damage
